Overview

Paris is a city in Île-de-France with a population of 2,161,000. The City of Light, a global center for art, fashion, gastronomy, and culture with iconic landmarks and world-class museums. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
